title: pyrobuilds: speeding up the exploration of large configuration spaces with incremental build
core_idea: Introduce Pyrobuilds, an approach that accelerates exploration of large configurable software spaces by reusing incremental builds while preserving reproducibility. It uses a configuration variation operator parameterized by two deny lists (to avoid problematic options) and a mutation size to control diversity, aiming to keep configurations close enough for efficient incremental reuse.
tldr: Pyrobuilds proposes using controlled, reproducible incremental builds—guided by deny lists and a mutation-size parameter—to explore huge configuration spaces more efficiently for large configurable systems such as Linux, BusyBox, and Toybox.
